text_blocks.snippet: American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) Blood Pressure Guidelines
The AAP recommends the following blood pressure (BP) guidelines for children and adolescents:

list.snippet: Normal: Less than the 90th percentile for age and gender
Elevated: Greater than or equal to the 90th percentile but less than the 95th percentile, or 120/80 mm Hg (whichever is lower)
Stage 1 Hypertension: Greater than or equal to the 95th percentile plus 12 mm Hg, or 130/80 to 139/89 mm Hg (whichever is lower)
Stage 2 Hypertension: Greater than or equal to 140/90 mm Hg
